thread:
maria (partnerships): quick sync? were building an SI onboarding kit (marketplace checklist, hands-on playbook, light cert). want to keep it low-friction for partners but operationally complete. suggestions on minimum deliverables?
sam_solutions: minimum = (1) 1-page partner overview for sellers, (2) install/run lab (1-hour), (3) infra checklist for Private installs, (4) contact matrix for escalation.
jess_ops: + include an incident runbook template. SIs need a clear path to open severity tickets and a cadence for escalations. here's a tiny example we used before: `sev1 -> 24/7 support -> on-call -> partner callback within 1h`
ravi_eng: on infra checklist: include OS image hash, kernel version, recommended CUDA/cuDNN, swap/storage settings, GPU firmware, and sample perf knobs. also recommend a minimal smoke test script we can supply.
emma_marketing: we'll create a co-branded one-pager and a short case blurb. can the team provide 2-3 sentences about value props & a small screenshot of Console metrics?
maria (partnerships): good. can we scope a 1-hour "lab" that proves an end-to-end flow (deploy model -> call API -> observe latency & cost)? keep it runnable in Dedicated or Private with ephemeral creds.
sam_solutions: yes. lab plan: prereqs, quick terraform to stand up infra, deploy sample model, hit endpoint with client, check Console traces, validate batching. passing criteria = successful inference + Console shows tokens consumed.
jess_ops: automation note: add a `cleanup` step so partner labs don't linger. script should revoke creds and delete tenant.
ravi_eng: i'll write the smoke test and provide a Docker image for the model runtime. also can surface a tiny `validate_gpu.sh` that checks CUDA + driver compatibility.
emma_marketing: legal wants a blurb for marketplace listing; legal-bot, can you advise on required text?
legal-bot: Suggested marketplace blurb: "Redwood Inference + PartnerName: high-performance LLM inference with predictable latency and enterprise controls. PartnerName provides integration and support for on-prem and cloud deployments. See docs for data residency and SLAs." (non-binding example)
maria (partnerships): thanks. timeline: drafts for playbook + lab + 1-pager by Tue (1741742400). who can commit?
sam_solutions: I'll draft the hands-on playbook and the lab steps.
ravi_eng: I'll push the smoke tests and `validate_gpu.sh` to the SI repo.
jess_ops: I'll draft incident runbook & cleanup automation hooks.
emma_marketing: I'll prep the 1-pager and screenshots. legal-bot: please share final blurb for marketplace copy.
maria (partnerships): certification idea: tiny badge with two tracks: "Implementation-Ready" (lab pass) and "Service-Partner" (lab + runbook review). low friction, yearly renewal. Sam, add pass criteria to the playbook.
sam_solutions: will include rubric. quick mock: ```
Implementation-Ready: 80% practical lab pass, 1 smoke test pass
Service-Partner: Implementation-Ready + runbook review + sample reference
Renewal: annual or after major infra change
```
emma_marketing: we can make a digital badge and a short profile for partners that pass.
maria (partnerships): ok, next steps: create GH issue to track tasks, set up a 30-min review on Wed. thanks all. :sparkles:
